summary: This clinical trial tested the study drug aleniglipron compared to a placebo in adults who have obesity or are overweight with at least one weight-related health condition. The study included 85 participants and looked at different doses of the drug over a 44-week period. The trial's status is Completed. You can find this study on ClinicalTrials.gov using the identifier NCT06703021.
